original_ai_output.title_zh: 塞内加尔暴雨引发洪灾致数人死亡，基础设施受损
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 塞内加尔首都达喀尔及该国其他地区遭遇强降雨和山洪，部分地区被淹。内政部确认有数人死亡或受伤，马塔姆一处墙体倒塌致一名25岁女子及其4岁孩子死亡。部分地区单日降雨量超过140毫米，造成基础设施和交通大面积受损，而数周后塞内加尔将举办青年奥运会。

key_facts.fact: 塞内加尔首都达喀尔及该国其他地区遭遇强降雨和山洪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Torrential rainfall and flash flooding left parts of Senegal’s capital Dakar underwater on Monday with other regions of the country also affected.

key_facts.fact: 内政部确认有数人死亡或受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ministry of Interior confirmed that several people have been killed or injured.

key_facts.fact: 马塔姆一处墙体倒塌致一名25岁女子及其4岁孩子死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A 25-year-old woman and her 4-year-old child died when a wall collapsed in Matam.

key_facts.fact: 部分地区单日降雨量超过140毫米，基础设施和交通大面积受损
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some areas received more than 140 mm of rain in a single day, causing widespread damage to infrastructure and transportation just weeks before Senegal is due to host the Youth Olympics.

uncertainties: 伤亡总人数尚未明确，仅称“数人”
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
